ac_results.ac: B2 held market past end+6h stays in markets until its position is zero
ac_results.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/wiring/test_ww_b.py -q (test_b2_held_market_past_end_stays_until_position_is_zero); code read of MarketData._set_markets
ac_results.evidence: The test passes. With held=None the market drops at end + 6 h. With held set it stays, including after it leaves the snapshot, and it drops once the position is 0. The code keeps a market when abs(held[token]) > 1e-9 for either token. trader.loop.Trader.positions is a bound method returning {token: shares net of redemptions}, so md.held = trader.positions fits the callable contract. If held() raises, _poll catches the error and skips that reload (markets are kept, which fails safe).

defects.description: With touch or universe_ext on, load_markets crawls again whenever the latest snapshot has no flagged template. The recorder's hourly flags-off crawl causes this. The re-crawl writes into the shared data/markets/ (crawler default out_dir), takes about 254 s live, and blocks MarketData start-up, possibly on every 5-minute reload. The builder disclosed this as a ponytail comment. A flags-off reader's market set is unaffected (B1 is verified with the extra rows present).
defects.fix_hint: WW-D should give flagged runs their own markets_dir (or MarketData a markets_dir parameter). Later, add a 'crawled with' marker so a missing template doesn't trigger a crawl on every reload.

defects.description: The router fix (fix 2) sits behind a constructor kwarg, PaperRouter(liquidity_once=False), not a dispatch flag. Paper/replay parity holds only once WW-D or the orchestrator passes True. Keeping it off is correct under ground rule 1 (flags off = Phase 1). The builder disclosed this.
defects.fix_hint: WW-D: tie liquidity_once to a features.py flag (for example in the paper-safe set) and pass it in loop.py.
